title: Troy Aikman: It seems like ESPN is going to go in a different direction

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Troy Aikman: It seems like ESPN is going to go in a different direction
sources.description: Hall of Fame quarterback and ESPN/ABC Monday Night Football analyst Troy Aikman made some waves on Thursday morning by creating the clear impression that he's planning to leave after his current contract expires, after Super Bowl LXI.
